description: Two production builds as successive releases in event mode. The webpack path injects chunk ids and the release into every client and server chunk before hashing; the Turbopack path uses native debug ids and uploads from runAfterProductionCompile. A Pages API route captures two exceptions server-side through an externalized posthog-node; both must resolve to their source lines and carry the release. On the Turbopack path the release reaches neither an externalized posthog-node nor a CDN posthog-js: no runtime module sets _posthogReleaseId there, so server exceptions resolve but carry no release.
